note: Independent re-audit after 26d70dfa0d. The tagged roots still prove attachment on the normal paths: the zero-GR real-RIB root requires literal 0xffff0006 at level 2, TestAttachCommunity the pooled bytes, the fresh-route negative no attachment to fresh routes, and the new TestRFC9494ConsecutiveRestartMarksTheLaterConnectionsRoutes requires LLGR_STALE at level 2 on the routes connection 42 delivered for a family already in LLGR (restalePreservedLLGR). FINDING, single restart: the same commit made llgrFamilyActive return false once reestablishedConnectionID is set, and wireStateCallbacks' onLLGREnter checks it before NO_LLGR removal, before attach-community and before the level-2 mark. When the successor's UP lands while a Restart-Time-expiry LLGR entry is dispatching, the LLGR period has begun (its LLST timer keeps running through synchronization) but the retained stale routes keep level 1 and no LLGR_STALE until End-of-RIB, LLST expiry or a later DOWN; nothing completes the entry on reconnect (only restalePreservedLLGR at the next DOWN), and the RIB safety timer armed by the DOWN mark-stale stays armed. Section 4.2 says these procedures MUST be performed once the Restart Time period ends. The untagged TestRFC9494ConsecutiveRestartCompletesARevokedLLGREntry asserts that undecorated state at lines 276-278 as expected, and no tagged root can fail on it. Before this commit llgrFamilyActive kept true after reconnect, so the entry completed. Suspected code defect, not verified by a run.
